title: Korean Vegetable Rice Bowl with Fried Egg and Chilli Sauce
summary: A colourful rice bowl with sautéed vegetables, a crisp-edged fried egg, and a sweet-spicy Korean-style chilli sauce. It’s a quick, satisfying lunch with plenty of fresh flavour and a little heat.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it in the water with a pinch of salt until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes. Keep it covered off the heat for 5 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, sriracha, rice vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, and sliced chilli in a small bowl to make the chilli sauce.

Heat 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the garlic, carrot, courgette, and mushrooms, then stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until the vegetables are glossy and just tender.
Add the spinach and half the spring onions, then cook for 1 minute until the spinach has wilted. Season lightly with salt.
In a separate frying pan, heat the remaining vegetable oil and fry the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny, or cook longer if you prefer firm yolks.
Divide the rice between two bowls. Top with the vegetables, then place a fried egg on each bowl.
Drizzle over the chilli sauce and finish with the remaining spring onions. Serve immediately while everything is hot.
